annotations.title: Scan a file's metadata for privacy risks

description: Lists EXIF, XMP and PNG text metadata with a risk rating. Inspects JPEG, PNG, HEIC/HEIF, WebP, TIFF, AVIF, MP4/QuickTime, AVI, Matroska and WebM video (container metadata only). Any other format returns `supported: false` and `overall_risk: unknown`: nothing was inspected, so no findings does not mean no metadata. MCP tool: `scan_metadata`. Price: 0.002 USDC per file.
name: scan_metadata
